headline: Discussed remote meeting participation, trustee duties, and library director duties for the bylaws draft.
summary: Remote participation in meetings was discussed. The chair prefers a board vote on approval if the option is kept, and the secretary said state law requires the reason for remote participation to be recorded in the minutes. Trustee duties and library director duties were also discussed, and the secretary will prepare a draft for the full board to review.
plain_text:
Leach Library Board of Trustees
Bylaws Subcommittee Draft Meeting minutes
August 5, 2026 at 6 PM
Sunnycrest Room, Town Hall, Londonderry NH
Members Present:
 Nancy Hendricks, Chair
 Erica Laue, Secretary
Call to Order: Called by Secretary Laue at 6:05 PM.
Public Comment: None.
Discussion:
 Remote participation in meetings: Chair Hendricks prefers that if we retain this option, 
the Board should be able to vote on the approval. Secretary Laue notes that the statute 
requires that the reason for remote participation must be documented in the minutes. 
The RSA should be cited in the Bylaws
 Duties and responsibilities of Trustees
 Duties and responsibilities of the Library Director
Action Items:
 Secretary Laue will clean up the draft and prepare a copy for presentation and review by
the full Board.
 A next meeting will be scheduled as needed after presenting to the Board.
Public Comment: None.
Adjournment: 6:41 PM.
Minutes prepared by Secretary Laue.
